sentences.text:
Court No.34
 Item No. 15
 sg
 Crr 22 of 2025

In the matter of: Ravi Pratap Singh
 ...Petitioner.
 Mr. Shibojyoti Chakraborty
 Mr. Dhiman Banberjee
 Ms. Debolina Ghosh
 ...for the petitioner.
The matter pertains to complaint lodged by the present opposite party no.2, wife of the present petitioner under Section 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

Learned advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits, it is a case of counterblast to the complaint lodged by the present petitioner against his son ten days prior to such lodging of complaint.
Marriage between the parties is about 38 years and having three sons.
2. Since arguable case has been made out by the learned advocate of petitioner, the petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the opposite parties.
3. Meantime, the proceeding pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, Bidhannagar, North 24-parganas be stayed till 16th March, 2026 until further order whichever is earlier.
4. Petitioner directed to file affidavit of service at the time of hearing.

5. Matter to appear under the heading 'contested application' before the regular Bench.
6.
Parties are to act on the server copy of this order downloaded from the official website of the Calcutta High Court.

[Chaitali Chatterjee (Das), J.]
